argv:
set -e
export REIN_CH07_P1="$(mktemp -d)/case.json"
cp fixtures/cases/ch07-context.json "$REIN_CH07_P1"
node -e '''const fs=require("fs"); const p=process.argv[1]; const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p)); const c=x.cases.find(c=>c.id==="managed-window"); const m=c.history.find(m=>m.role==="tool" && m.toolCallId==="latest-a"); m.content="最新事实 A（已更正）"; fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(x));''' "$REIN_CH07_P1"
cargo run --quiet --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --example ch07_context -- "$REIN_CH07_P1" > /tmp/rein-ch07-rust-p1-v3.json
node -e '''const x=require("/tmp/rein-ch07-rust-p1-v3.json"); const c=x.cases.find(c=>c.id==="managed-window"); const expected="最新事实 A（已更正）\n最新事实 B"; if(c.result.answer!==expected){console.error(JSON.stringify({answer:c.result.answer,expected})); process.exit(1)} console.log(JSON.stringify({id:c.id,answer:c.result.answer,reason:c.result.reason,requests:c.result.requests}))'''
stdout: {"id":"managed-window","answer":"最新事实 A（已更正）\n最新事实 B","reason":"final_answer"}
